notes_for_editor: Brief record agrees with the register and firelookout.com on 5,520 ft, Union County, Oregon Dept. of Forestry and gone status; the Forest Association list agrees on coordinates and gone status, and firelookout.com shows no coordinates. Both build sources give only the 1930s, so the 1930 event year is a placeholder for the decade. No source describes the site today or its access, and no new photo was found. The Oregon Digital and Osborne panorama collections were not searched.
